usage.guide: Do not use this endpoint as-is. It is a QuestFlow x402 agent gateway for OKLink blockchain data; in theory you POST {"input":"<your question>"} and read the answer from body.response. In practice (tested 2026-06-08) it returns HTTP 201 and charges ~$0.10 per call but the backend replies {"response":"X402 Service is currently unavailable."} every time, so you pay and get nothing. Treat as broken and skip until the provider restores the backend.
